== =======================
 NAGENDRA PASWAN, aged about 55 years, Male, S/o Late Ramchandra  Prasad @ Mahendra Prasad R/o Village- Kolhua Paigamberpur, P.S.-
 Ahiyapur, Distt- Muzaffarpur. ... ...
Appellant/s  Versus  The State of Bihar ...
For the Appellant/s : Mr.Sunil Kumar Pandey, Advocate  For the Respondent/s : Mr.Syed Ashfaque Ahmad, APP

= =
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SHAILENDRA SINGH  ORAL ORDER 3 19-09-2023 1.
Heard learned counsel for the appellant and learned counsel for the State.

2. This appeal has been filed against the judgment of conviction dated 21.11.2022 and order of sentence dated 24.11.2022 passed by the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-VI-cum-Special Judge (POCSO Act), Muzaffarpur in connection with Ahiyapur P.S. Case No.481 of 2017 corresponding to POCSO G.R. No.39 of 2018 whereby the appellant has been convicted for the offences punishable under Section 376/511 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 8 and 10 of POCSO Act and sentenced for the said offences.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge-VI-cum-Special Judge (POCSO Act), Muzaffarpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
3. Learned counsel for the appellant presses the bail prayer of the appellant made under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C.
4. State has filed written objection to the said prayer.

5. The main submissions advanced by learned counsel for the appellant are that the alleged offence punishable under Patna High Court CR. APP (SJ) No.176 of 2023(3) dt.19-09-2023 Section 376/511 of IPC, for which the appellant has been mainly convicted, is not made out and as per the prosecution's allegation, the alleged offence took place on 18.06.2017 but the FIR was lodged on 24.06.2017 and the said delay was not explained by the prosecution during trial of the appellant.

Further submissions are that during trial the witnesses examined by the prosecution are close relatives of the victim and the appellant has undergone about 17 months in jail and during trial, he remained on bail and in actual in between both the parties there was a dispute of flowing of water in Nagendra Paswan vs The State Of Bihar on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/180399441/
1 a drain, owing to which the allegation was falsely made against the appellant.
6.

entities.text: Nagendra Paswan vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned APP appearing for the State has vehemently opposed the bail prayer of the appellant.

7. Considering the seriousness of the accusation which relates to the outraging the modesty of seven years old victim allegedly committed by this appellant, this Court is not inclined to accept his bail prayer for the present.
Accordingly, his bail prayer stands rejected.

Sanjay/- (Shailendra Singh, J)
